words.ex: The barista made my cappuccino with a shot of espresso and thick milk foam, then drew a little heart on top.
Aunt Feruza orders a large latte every morning; it's mostly hot milk with just a little coffee in it.
Our maths teacher likes her coffee strong, with no milk and no sugar, so she always orders a black coffee.
On hot days the kids order a strawberry milkshake made from cold milk and vanilla ice cream.
For breakfast I put a banana, an apple and some yoghurt in the blender and make a thick smoothie.
After skating outside in the snow, we warmed up with big mugs of hot chocolate, made from cocoa and milk, with marshmallows on top.
Mum drinks herbal tea with mint and camomile before bed because it helps her relax.
Coffee in the evening keeps my uncle awake, but he loves its taste, so after six o'clock he orders decaf instead.
The café serves a warm waffle with honey and berries, and the honey collects in the little squares.
A boy behind me opened a bag of crisps on the bus, and everyone could hear him crunching.
The burger came with a plate of hot French fries and a little pot of ketchup.
For a quick lunch I had a cheese toastie, so hot from the toaster that the cheese was melting out.
At the station café I bought a chicken and tomato panini, pressed flat and grilled in an Italian sandwich machine.
On the way to school, Kamola grabbed a sesame bagel with cream cheese and ate it round the hole in the middle.
I ordered a chicken wrap: grilled meat and salad rolled up inside a thin flatbread.
Our neighbour came home from the bakery with a long French baguette under her arm, still warm.
In the hotel café I had a buttery croissant, curved like a new moon, with my tea.
My favourite snack is a blueberry muffin, soft inside with a golden top and no icing at all.
For my birthday, Mum baked twelve cupcakes with pink icing and a candle on each one.
The large cup was too much for me last time, so today I asked for a regular one.
I was really thirsty after football, so I ordered the biggest size: a large orange juice.
It was raining, so I ordered my hot chocolate to have in and found a seat by the window.
I was late for the bus, so I bought my tea to take away and drank it on the way.
My lunch had gone cold while I was chatting, so the waiter offered to heat up my soup in the microwave.
Ketchup dripped onto my fingers, so I wiped them with a paper napkin.
I carried our four cups to the table on a plastic tray without spilling a drop.
Sprinkle some grated cheese over the hot pasta and wait until it melts.
The sandwich had thin slices of pink ham and a leaf of lettuce inside.
Coffee and strong tea both contain caffeine, which can keep you awake at night.
